faq.title: What a business owner asks before opening an account

items.a: Growlab is for any merchant or e-commerce business in Oman and the GCC (whether using Salla, Zid, Shopify, Instagram, or WhatsApp; with Cash-on-Delivery, Card payments, or Bank transfer).

items.q: What is the Competitor Radar & GCC Ad Intelligence?
items.a: An intelligence engine that tracks rival ad campaigns active for 30+ days in the GCC, calculates Threat Scores, analyzes weaknesses, and crafts winning counter-strategy hooks.

items.q: How does Growlab calculate True Net Profit?
items.a: Net Profit = Total Revenue - (COGS + Ad Spend + Actual Courier Fees + RTO Return Losses + Payment Gateway Fees).

items.q: What is the No-Find No-Fee Guarantee?
items.a: You pay a nominal monthly subscription for full access, and performance fees (10%) are calculated only on actual leaked funds identified and recovered. If no leaks are found, you pay zero performance fees.

items.q: Do I need complex API integrations?
items.a: No, you can input numbers easily or upload Excel/CSV courier statements. Our engine automatically structures and matches the data.

founders.title: One founder. Built a distribution network, not a store.
founders.name: Qusay Nader Al-Nabarawi
founders.p1: I am Qusay, a cybersecurity student first. The first question I ask about any system is: "Where is the gap?" I built Growlab on that question, not on a ready marketing slogan.
founders.p2: A platform that handles merchant budgets and money has to be hardened against fraud by design. That is what actually protects your campaign cap and your money, not just on paper.
founders.p3: Five years in real marketing — campaigns, budgets, real clients. I am not building a theoretical system; I am building it for a merchant who needs customers on performance from day one.
founders.quote: We only earn if you earn. That is the whole difference.

suspended.lede: Operations paused the account pending review. Check the warning or contact Growlab.

pending.title: Your documents are in review.
pending.merchant: We'll audit the commercial registration and owner identity before your products go live. You'll enter the merchant dashboard as soon as you're verified.
pending.creator: We'll match your ID photos with the four liveness stills. You can start promoting only after approval.

merchant.title: Prove the business is real.
merchant.lede: Nobody goes live as a merchant without a commercial registration and owner ID. Upload the documents — an admin audits them before you can list products.
merchant.commercialRegHint: As printed on the Ministry of Commerce certificate.

creator.title: Photograph your ID, then your face.
creator.lede: Capture the national ID front and back, then four liveness poses: look right, left, up, and down. An admin checks they match before you can promote.
creator.legalName: Full legal name (as on the ID)
creator.cameraDenied: Camera access is required. Allow it in the browser, then reload.
creator.idGuide: Fill the frame with the card. No glare, all four corners visible.
creator.faceGuide: Hold still, even light, no sunglasses or mask.

hints.national_id_front: Hold the front of the ID toward the camera.
hints.national_id_back: Flip the card. Capture the back in full.
hints.face_right: Turn your head to the right and hold.
hints.face_left: Turn your head to the left and hold.
hints.face_up: Tilt your chin up and hold.
hints.face_down: Tilt your chin down and hold.

storefrontEditor.title: Shape your public page
storefrontEditor.lede: Pick the hero piece, write the copy visitors read first, then publish — prices stay locked to your deal.
storefrontEditor.creatorOnly: Switch to a creator profile in the dev role switcher to use the storefront editor.
storefrontEditor.noDeals: No verified deals yet — a merchant needs to assign you an active product first.

start.title: Which piece leads?
start.lede: The hero is the first thing visitors see beside your name — usually the piece from your latest video.

compose.title: Write what they read
compose.lede: Your tagline and product note. Keep it short — visitors decide in seconds.
compose.bioHint: Shown under your name on the storefront.
compose.notePlaceholder: Same cut, same cloth. One short run.
compose.noteHint: Leave blank to use category and tags from the deal.
compose.lockedHint: Price and commission cannot be edited here — they are fixed at deal assignment.

preview.lede: This is how your storefront will look. Nothing is saved until you publish.

published.title: Your storefront is live
published.lede: Share the link anywhere. In this prototype, changes are not persisted — the flow demonstrates the editor experience.

merchantStore.contactLede: Order COD from the product page — we deliver to your address.

merchantStoreEditor.title: Build your store step by step
merchantStoreEditor.lede: Smart setup: pick your business, we build the store, then you edit and publish.
merchantStoreEditor.noProducts: Add one product first — then we open the store editor.
merchantStoreEditor.aiFailed: Could not generate. Try again or continue manually.

start.title: Your store is ready to build
start.lede: Three simple steps. Let AI draft the first version, or start yourself.
start.step1: Write the store name and a short story.
start.step2: Pick a color and the product that shows first.
start.step3: Add an offer if you want, then publish the link.
start.aiHint: AI suggests copy and colors from your products — you can edit everything after.
start.proAiHint: AI assistant and store offers are available on Pro.

identity.title: Store identity
identity.lede: What customers see when they open your link.

look.title: Look & feel
look.lede: Pick a color and layout — the preview updates live.

offer.title: Offer banner
offer.lede: A strip at the top for seasonal or launch offers.

preview.contactLede: Order COD from the product page — we deliver to your address.

promo.headline: Offer headline
promo.endsAtHint: Leave empty to keep it until you cancel.
promo.aiPlaceholder: e.g. buy 2 get the 3rd free, or 20% off the second item
promo.aiFailed: Could not suggest. Try another phrase or pick a preset.

fields.taglineHint: One line under the store name.
fields.taglinePlaceholder: Example: Muttrah attars — Muscat delivery, cash on delivery
fields.aboutHint: Write normal paragraphs. Blank line = new paragraph. No HTML needed.
fields.aboutPlaceholder:
Welcome to our store…

We pick products carefully and deliver to your door.
fields.heroHint: Tap a product to show it at the top.
fields.offerActive: Show offer banner at the top
fields.offerBodyPlaceholder: Pay cash on delivery — we deliver to your address.

published.title: Your store is live
published.lede: Share the link with customers. COD orders land on your dashboard.
published.draftLede: Draft saved. Publish when you like the preview.

odoo.nextProductHint: Store is live — add your first product to open the campaign and sales.

start.title: Start now
start.freeAccess: Instant free access — no credit card required.
start.legal: By clicking Start now, you accept the subscription agreement and privacy policy

config.detailPlaceholder: e.g. Muttrah attars, salon, clothing store…

blocks.libraryHint: Tap a block to add it to the page, then reorder or hide it in page structure.
blocks.pickBlock: Pick a block from Blocks or from page structure.
blocks.contactHint: The contact section shows your store name and city. Orders happen on product pages with cash on delivery.

activation.title: Activate your store to continue
activation.body: To keep your store running, complete activation with the email on your account.

shop.buyCod: Buy — ship now, product on delivery
shop.codHint: Shipping is paid now. Product price on delivery if you choose that. Your phone tracks the order.
shop.checkoutLede: Shipping is prepaid. Product on delivery, or pay everything now. Enter your phone carefully.
shop.phoneTrackHint: The same number unlocks your share link and commission tracking later — enter it carefully.
shop.payCod: Product on delivery — shipping paid now
shop.payCard: Pay product and shipping now — held until the delivery window
shop.deliveryWindow: Delivery within {days} days at most. If you prepay the product we hold it until then. Shipping is always paid now.
shop.orderFailed: Could not place the order. Try again.
shop.emptyCartLede: Add a piece from the store, then come back to check out.
shop.trackLede: Hello {name}. The merchant ships through the platform — no phone numbers exchanged.
shop.returnsPolicy: For a return or support, use this page and your order reference. Do not contact the merchant or marketer off-platform.
shop.holdLede: If you paid on the platform, money stays held until the product’s delivery window. Arrived on time, or you did not claim after it lapsed — it goes to the merchant. Late and you claim — it comes back to you.
shop.receiveLede: Yes releases funds to the merchant. No keeps them frozen. This link works once.
shop.receiveNo: No, I did not receive it
shop.shareLede: Share link is ready right after checkout. Open it, activate, and film unboxing when the product arrives.

payLede.pending: Prepare the link now. Commission does not leave the spend cap until you confirm pay on delivery.
payLede.confirmed: Paid on delivery. Commission taken. Share on WhatsApp.
payLede.void: Not paid on delivery. No commission.

escrow.held: Held on the ledger until collection is confirmed
escrow.released: Released on the ledger after collection
